generate_when: the source explicitly uses a metaphor or example and the visual makes the mechanism easier to understand
the idea can be expressed as one concrete action by the lemon character
the image adds a cognitive anchor instead of repeating the paragraph
skip_when: the sentence is literal despite matching a trigger word
real evidence or a real chart is the correct visual
the proposed image is only a decorative mascot
the same metaphor or pose has already appeared nearby

story_grammars.literalized_metaphor: Turn an abstract phrase into one absurd physical action.
story_grammars.example_micro_story: Use setup -> action -> result, normally one image or 2-3 panels.
story_grammars.contrast: Show two systems or choices with one stable left/right comparison.
story_grammars.causal_machine: Use a machine, relay, pipe, gate, conveyor, or bridge to show transmission.
story_grammars.constraint_risk: Use weight, bottleneck, thin bridge, leak, pit, or stuck mechanism.
story_grammars.scale_ratio: Use exaggerated object size while keeping labels sparse.
story_grammars.cycle_time: Use a wheel, loop, season, or conveyor with one highlighted phase.
story_grammars.counterintuitive_twist: Reveal a reversed direction, upside-down rule, or unexpected operator action.

wechat_article.density: normally 1 illustration per 500-900 Chinese characters; 4-8 for a long article
wechat_article.caption: optional one-line interpretation; never repeat the paragraph

talking_head_video.motion: setup -> character action -> result -> speaker or evidence return

explainer_html_video.motion: setup -> character action -> result -> evidence or chapter continuation

vox_explainer_video.motion: setup -> character action -> result -> direct evidence return

digital_human_video.motion: setup -> character action -> result -> active presenter or evidence return
